description: [100% FREE — Zero API Key Needed] Build a multi-scene Bangladeshi Bengali UGC / Video storyboard (Hook -> Problem -> Showcase -> Social Proof -> CTA) with Bengali narration scripts, Romanized Banglish phonetic guides, on-screen captions, and .SRT subtitles.

ctaTextBn.description: Optional call-to-action in Bengali (e.g. "এখনই অর্ডার করুন").

deliveryNoteBn.description: Optional delivery/warranty note in Bengali (e.g. "সারা দেশে ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি").

offerPriceBn.description: Optional offer or price in Bengali (e.g. "মাত্র ৯৯০ টাকা").

productName.description: Product, brand, or video topic name (leave empty for general video narration).

sceneCount.description: Number of scenes to generate (default: 5, min: 1, max: 12).

sceneDurationSec.description: Duration per scene in seconds (default: 4, min: 2, max: 30).
